# proxmox_node_migrateall (Resource)

Migrates all guests of a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/migrateall` and waits for the worker.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_migrateall" "m" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  target   = "pve-2"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `target` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number)
- `vms` (Set of Number)
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
